postJobGuide.title: Project Request Guide
postJobGuide.subtitle: Choose the most suitable job creation method for your needs. We support both AI-powered automation and traditional manual input.
postJobGuide.aiModeDesc: Describe the project outcome you need. AI will prepare a title, requirement details, category, and helpful expertise.
postJobGuide.manualModeDesc: Set up and fill in each job information field yourself according to your structure. Ideal when you have a fully prepared requirement document (JD) ready in advance.
postJobGuide.guide1Desc: Explain the objective, context, constraints, inputs, and expected deliverables. The freelancer will propose the work breakdown and milestone payment plan in their proposal.
postJobGuide.guide2Desc: Optional questions help freelancers clarify assumptions or missing information in their proposal. They are not a test or mandatory interview.
postJobGuide.guide2Tip1: Ask situational questions: Instead of general questions, ask how to handle a specific issue. E.g., "How would you handle API overload or slow response?".
postJobGuide.guide2Tip2: Ask about equivalent product experience: E.g., "Please share a link or screenshot of an app you coded using similar state management.".
postJobGuide.guide2Tip3: Limit the number of questions: Stick to 2–3 truly valuable questions to avoid discouraging freelancers from applying.
postJobGuide.guide3Desc: Do not share direct contact or sensitive information in the request. Contract signing and escrow happen only after a proposal and final offer are agreed.

postJob.instantGuideDesc: When enabled, a prompt input bar appears at the bottom. Describe your job requirements in the bar and click Generate Details to let AI automatically fill in the Job Title, Category, Description, and required Skills.

aiGenJobGuide.title: Effective AI Gen Job Guide
aiGenJobGuide.subtitle: AI will automatically generate the job title, category, skills, and detailed description based on your prompt. Follow these 4 steps for the best professional results.
aiGenJobGuide.step1Body: Provide the full job title and experience level. Avoid vague names like "developer" — be specific: "Senior React Developer", "Junior Data Analyst", "Mid-level UI/UX Designer".
aiGenJobGuide.step2Body: Clearly specify the required languages, frameworks, tools, and years of experience. For example: "requires TypeScript, REST API, PostgreSQL — min 2 years experience". AI will automatically map these to the matching skills catalog.
aiGenJobGuide.step3Body: Mention the project scope, expected budget range, and timeline. For example: "3-month project, budget 5-10 million VND, to be completed before September 2026". This helps AI tailor the description accurately.
aiGenJobGuide.step4Body: After AI finishes generating, always review and adjust the content to align with your company culture and actual needs. AI might miss some context — you know your requirements best.
tips: You can write in either English or Vietnamese
The more detailed the prompt → the more accurate the results
Generate as many times as you like for free
AI-suggested skills can be manually adjusted after generating
examples: "Hiring a Senior React Developer proficient in TypeScript + Next.js, with 3+ years of experience in REST APIs and state management (Zustand/Redux). E-commerce project, scope 4 months, remote, budget 3,000–5,000 G-coin."
"Need a UI/UX Designer to design a fintech mobile app (iOS + Android) in Figma. Must have experience with design systems, user research, and developer handoff. 6 weeks, budget 15–20 million VND."
